candidate_examples.name: Escherichia coli lipid A biosynthesis
candidate_examples.evidence: The regulation of LpxC in the model organism Escherichia coli has been the subject of immense study

candidate_examples.name: Pseudomonas aeruginosa LpxC activation by MurA
candidate_examples.evidence: it was revealed that Pa LpxC is regulated by a wholly unique mechanism: it is activated by direct binding to the committed enzyme in the competing PG biosynthetic pathway, MurA

candidate_examples.name: Neisseria meningitidis Ght-dependent LpxC regulation
candidate_examples.evidence: the N. meningitidis LapB homolog Ght was suggested to regulate LpxC through an FtsH-independent mechanism by localizing LpxC to the IM to promote LPS biosynthesis

candidate_examples.name: Agrobacterium tumefaciens Lon-mediated LpxC degradation
candidate_examples.evidence: when heterologously expressed in E. coli, both A. tumefaciences and R. capsulatus LpxC was degraded... due to the Lon protease

candidate_examples.name: Rhodobacter capsulatus Lon-mediated LpxC degradation
candidate_examples.evidence: when heterologously expressed in E. coli, both A. tumefaciences and R. capsulatus LpxC was degraded... due to the Lon protease

candidate_examples.name: Rhodobacter sphaeroides NtrYX regulation of LpxC transcription
candidate_examples.evidence: In R. sphaeroides, an ntrYX mutant exhibited approximately nine-fold elevated lpxC transcript abundance and two-fold accumulation of LPS compared with the WT

candidate_examples.name: Caulobacter crescentus NtrYX/ChvGI regulation of LpxC transcription
candidate_examples.evidence: In C. crescentus, an additional layer of control is imposed by the ChvGI two component system, which activates lpxC transcription

candidate_examples.name: Cronobacter sakazakii LabP activation of LpxA
candidate_examples.evidence: labP mutants had reduced core-lipid A and increased GPL levels... addition of purified LabP was sufficient to stimulate LpxA activity in vitro

candidate_examples.name: Francisella tularensis RipA interaction with LpxA
candidate_examples.evidence: In Francisella tularensis, LpxA interacts with another protein, RipA, that is required for replication within host cells

candidate_examples.name: Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium PbgA-LapB regulation
main_subprocesses: stationary-phase LpxC proteolysis via PbgA-LapB complex
candidate_examples.evidence: even in the close E. coli relative S. Typhimurium, slight deviations from the YejM-LPS-LapB partner switching model have been suggested
